results.dataset_description: 24 four-way multiple-choice questions on synchrotron light-source science: accelerator physics, beamline optics, and X-ray techniques. Zero-shot. Random baseline 0.250; always-best-position baseline 0.333. Known artifact: correct answers are longer than distractors (38.8 vs 27.3 chars on average), so acc_norm is the honest headline metric and a high acc alone should not be read as domain knowledge.
